the structure and function of the TRAIL protein and its interaction with the cell surface receptors and with the soluble decoy receptors.
the structural basis of TRAIL-mediated apoptosis.
the structure determination of human recombinant TRAIL, which will be the basis for further studies on the structure of the TRAIL-receptor interaction.

the crystal structure of TRAIL will provide important information about the molecular basis of its interaction with its receptors.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the crystallization of TRAIL is a success, but that its structure determination is a failure.
